title: Engine swap: HyperFrames against Motion
caption: One 9-second Magnifito storyboard rendered by both engines, side by side: HyperFrames on the left, the spring-based Motion engine on the right. The brief, brand, copy and scene timing are identical; because Motion only accepts motion-* recipes, each scene uses the closest recipe of each engine (kinetic type, a four-row service layout, a logo end card).
prompt: Use the magnifito-promo skill to compare the two render engines on one storyboard. Plan a 9.2-second 16:9 Magnifito promo with three scenes: "Great businesses stay invisible online" in big type (3 s), "Grow with Magnifito" with four service lines: websites, social media, email and ads, automation (3.8 s), and the logo with "Marketing with heart and value" (2.4 s). Render it once with engine hyperframes (hyperframes/: kinetic-typography, isometric-feature-grid, brand-title) and once with engine motion (motion/: motion-kinetic-type, motion-card-morph, motion-logo-reveal). Keep the brief, brand, copy and timing identical and change only the engine and the recipes. Put the two renders side by side with mgvideo multicam and label each half in Geist from fonts/ (labels.svg).
commands: mgvideo multicam work/hyperframes.mp4 work/motion.mp4 --layout side-by-side -o work/side-by-side.mp4
ffmpeg -i work/side-by-side.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v][1:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -an -t 9.2 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium work/engine.mp4
